digest.component_or_area: reconciler committed cache and tickets-store repository
propositions: tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% from reconciler .bridge_state cache; baseline_advanced_at field changes 1144 entries per pass without being read anywhere in src/
marginal packed cost per bindings.json version is 12.79 KB today; deleting timestamp reduces to 1.74 KB (7.4x) and moving rotation bookkeeping halves version count (12.8x total)
reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners so .bridge_state must stay on-branch; prior design with prev in main-branch worktree forced re-derivation of 2050+ inbound creates per pass

history-strip via git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges while restoring current files to byte-identical HEAD tree

rollout requires two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state to produce byte-identical bindings.json with no commit, and epoch-mismatch fail-closed behavior at both sync._union_merge and push.py

post-publish rollback is operator-controlled ref replacement with bundle verification, writer reset, and epoch-mismatch refusal preservation; non-resumable graph assertions run on scratch clone before either direction
